case: Blue Wattle messy June close readiness
client_context: Synthetic 28-employee trades services group with realistic close mess: mismatched payment references, stale bank reconciliation, late adjustment journal, ambiguous approval, wrong-period BAS and missing related-party statement.
buyer_persona: CAS/bookkeeping operations partner or head of client accounting who owns close quality and reviewer capacity in a 20–50 person firm.

blocker_count.packet_ready_requires: zero unresolved blockers plus manager sign-off; waiting-review, rejected/problem, missing, stale, ambiguous and wrong-period all block close

rules.label: Only reviewer can accept evidence
rules.citation: ReviewerDecision.accept requires role=reviewer; staff/client attempts are refusal events.

rules.label: Chase only unresolved blockers
rules.citation: Chase.include statuses rejected/problem, missing, stale, ambiguous, waiting-client; exclude accepted/waiting-review.

rules.label: Wrong-period support cannot close June
rules.citation: Evidence.period must equal case.period unless reviewer records explicit adjustment.

rules.label: Every refusal/transition appends actor, timestamp, evidence id, prior, next and rule
rules.citation: Events are append-only; duplicate sends and duplicate accepts are refused.

items.name: Payroll variance support
items.problem: 14% payroll variance; explanation received but not reviewer-accepted
items.risk: High materiality; packet exclusion until accepted

items.name: BAS export
items.problem: Wrong period: May export uploaded for June close
items.risk: GST control evidence would be misstated

items.name: Bank reconciliation
items.problem: Reconciliation dated 24 June; close requires 30 June
items.risk: Cash position may omit late transactions

items.name: Late adjustment journal
items.source_system: Journal entry list + Slack approval screenshot
items.problem: Approval screenshot lacks approver name and posted timestamp
items.next: Reviewer requests named approval or rejects.

items.name: Supplier payment reference
items.problem: Payment reference INV-4417 does not match invoice INV-4471

pilot.term: 3 weeks; 2 client closes; sample/redacted data only after DPA/security approval
pilot.baseline: Prior two closes: 18 duplicate asks, 7.5 reviewer rework hours, 26 manager-handoff hours, 4 unclear close calls
pilot.target: Reduce duplicate asks by 6+, reviewer rework by 2+ hours, handoff delay under 8 hours after final decision, manager can state can/cannot close in under 2 minutes
pilot.expansion: If 3 of 4 metrics pass, propose AUD $2,000–$4,000/month team plan or integration discovery; cancel if scorecard not measurable.
